Container.Name: BorgBackupServer
Container.Overview: Self-hosted web app for centrally managing BorgBackup across Linux, macOS and Windows endpoints. A lightweight agent polls the server over HTTPS and backs up over SSH — no inbound connections to endpoints, so it works behind firewalls/NAT. After first boot, view the container log for the auto-generated admin password (unless you set ADMIN_PASS). Set the Web UI Port host value, then set APP_URL to http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:THAT-PORT so agents can reach the server.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface.

Config.Name: SSH Port (agent borg)
Config.Description: Host port agents use to reach the server over SSH for borg. Must match the SSH_PORT variable below.

Config.Name: Data (/var/bbs)
Config.Description: All data: database, borg repositories, SSH keys, config. Point this at an array/pool share with enough space for your backups.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: The URL agents use to reach this server. Should be http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:WEB-UI-PORT (or a domain/https if you put a reverse proxy in front).

Config.Name: SSH_PORT
Config.Description: Must match the host SSH Port above so agents connect to the right port.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASS
Config.Description: Optional. Admin password set on first run only. Leave blank to auto-generate (shown in the container log).
